hypothesis: Agents may learn to associate literal original public mission target with a *selected observable* public front-cell disappearance, and retroactively credit earlier selected transitions when a delayed *true original terminal reward* occurs. The signal is observational and does not prove possession, objective completion, or causation.

native_design.wingless: opt-in native Go MG23 wrapper around unchanged MG19 DK16/DK13 source-only learner
native_design.yggdrasil: independent opt-in Python local-cell MG23 wrapper around unchanged MG19 R20/R17 learner
native_design.source_observed_target_effect: selected genuine source action, matching front public object target/color before and public empty type 1 afterwards, same source mission and heading; no hidden inventory
native_design.learned_context: exact original mission + public front object's triple + public heading; context hashed to bounded canonical source record, no hidden location
native_design.action_reward: NO artificial reward to parent; only actual original env.step reward reaches parent
native_design.target_signal_credit: one count on selected public target-disappearance transition; never from imagined or counterfactual actions
native_design.eligibility_credit: on actual positive terminal original source reward only, increment previous <=32 selected context-action receipts by distance-weight 33-(t-i), maximum 32 per event
native_design.action_selection: retain MG19 parent proposal; only override with a previously observed own context-action signal, score=8*target_effect_count + delayed_credit_weight, tie retain parent; no hand-coded objective action or route
native_design.cold_checkpoint: SHA-authenticated deterministic snapshot of unchanged parent and bounded selected transition stats; restore exact snapshot and counters

controls.independent_conventional: fresh separately coded tabular public context-action transition stats with identical real selected observations and the same eligibility window, reward weighting, training budget, and source action availability
